# Blackline 0.15.99

* **Missed calls show again.** A ring nobody answered wrote nothing down once calls were held open; now it does — "No answer" on the caller's side, "Missed call" on the other, in the DM list and the stream.
* The version also sits, tiny, beside the title at the top — the word stays centred.
* The big card holds still when you change tabs.
